definitions.gloss: rack; shelf; stand; frame for storage or display
definitions.explanation: An open framework or shelving structure used for organizing, storing, or displaying items. Common in homes, offices, and shops.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}をラックに{並|なら}べた。
examples.english: I lined up the books on the rack.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいラックを{買|か}って{部屋|へや}を{片付|かたづ}けた。
examples.english: I bought a new rack and tidied up the room.

examples.japanese: サーバーラックの{設置|せっち}には{十分|じゅうぶん}なスペースと{冷却|れいきゃく}{設備|せつび}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Installing a server rack requires sufficient space and cooling equipment.

notes:
From English "rack." A broadly used loanword for various types of open shelving and storage frames. Unlike {棚|たな} (shelf), ラック emphasizes the open-frame structure and often implies something that can be assembled or reconfigured.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メタルラック: metal rack; wire shelving
- マガジンラック: magazine rack
- スパイスラック: spice rack
- サーバーラック: server rack
- ラックに{置|お}く: to put on a rack
- ラックを{組|く}み{立|た}てる: to assemble a rack

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {棚|たな}: shelf — a native Japanese word for any shelf, including built-in or enclosed shelving
- シェルフ: shelf — a less common English loanword, used mainly in furniture branding
- スタンド: stand — for vertical display or holding a single item upright
